messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're planning a small pricing-page experiment next week: introduce an inline cost calculator + refresh tier names and a few FAQ copy tweaks. Draft doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx (pls don't edit until I lock). Need copy + QA + tracking plan. Can folks review by EOD Thu?

sam: I can take FAQ copy. Quick q — what's the hypothesis & primary metric?

maria: Hypothesis: clearer tier labels + an inline estimator will reduce 'contact sales' clicks by ~15% and increase self-serve signups. Primary metric = signup CTA conversion rate on pricing. Secondary = clicks on Contact Sales.

ben: I'll own the embed work. Do we have the calculator spec and the embed snippet yet?

lia: Putting the prototype snippet here for eng to use, still rough:```html
<iframe src=\"https://calc-stage.redwood.ai/embed?v=1&theme=light\" width=560 height=420 frameborder=0></iframe>
```

ben: perfect, thx @lia. We'll instrument GA4 events: pricing_calculate (when calc used), pricing_estimate_value (value), and pricing_contact_click. Need the event names final.

robin-sales: We'll need a mapping for inbound routing. If estimated_monthly > 10000 or user selects 'Dedicated', route to AE queue. Otherwise route to MQL flow. Can you add a hidden field with estimated_MRR?

maria: yes — add hidden 'estimated_MRR' and utm_source/utm_campaign. Sales, is that threshold good? @robin-sales

robin-sales: yep — we'll pick up via webhook. Also can you include a checkbox for 'interested in dedicated capacity' so we can triage faster.

sam: Tier naming suggestion — current draft uses: Starter / Scale / Dedicated. Suggestion: Starter / Growth / Dedicated — 'Scale' felt technical in user tests. Thoughts?

elaine: Legal flag — avoid language implying guaranteed SLAs on the public page. Recommend: "SLA-backed options available for Dedicated plans" instead of implying all tiers have SLAs.

maria: good catch, will update copy.

ben: timeline from eng: we can merge embed + events to staging by Wed (PR #1234). Need final event names and the calc iframe URL to be stable.

deploy-bot: PR merged to staging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pricing-calculator/pull/1234 by ben (:white_check_mark:)

maria: Awesome — final asks from marketing: 1) Sam — update FAQ Q2/Q3 for calculator edge-cases (rounding, currency). 2) Design — change primary CTA on pricing from 'Get started' -> 'Estimate your cost' for the experiment. 3) Sales — confirm routing webhook fields. 4) Eng — confirm analytics events and stable iframe URL.

sam: On it — will push FAQ copy changes to the doc and drop a diff here by EOD Thu.

lia: I'll update the design frames in Figma and add a new CTA variant; linking when done.

robin-sales: Confirmed webhook fields. Will monitor MQLs.

elaine: Approved updated legal phrasing. No other compliance blockers.

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll run the A/B for 3 weeks, measure signup CTA lift and contact-sales reduction. If anyone sees odd telemetry after rollout ping #eng-oncall and I'll escalate. :rocket:

ben: I'll follow up with a staging link once deployed.

deploy-bot: Staging build deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing (build 2026-09-12-042)

maria: closing thread — feel free to DM with questions. Thanks! :tada:
